answer.thought: The morning light is turning the dust motes in the study into a slow, golden suspension. I have written the opening sentences to Dr. Lindner, but the argument feels thin, as if I am trying to force a square peg into a round hole. The air outside is hazy with an index of 150, a visible fog that mirrors the moral haze in my mind regarding the state of this nation. I will sit with it for a moment longer, letting the silence of the room do the work of synthesis.
